children.value: > Fact From Story | Google was caught faking a Gemini demo by tuning text prompts with still images off camera.
> > Fact From Story | Google touted Gemini’s coding capabilities and multimodal prowess, claiming that the model can understand images, audio and videos just as well as text.
> > > Fact From Story | Gemini Pro is strictly text-in, text-out.
> > > Commonsense Knowledge | If a product is text-in, text-out, it cannot understand images, audio, and videos.
> > Commonsense Knowledge | A company touting the capabilities of a product suggests they want to create a favorable impression of it.
> Commonsense Knowledge | Faking a demo involves presenting a false or misleading representation of a product's capabilities.
